name: PR_TAIL loses its end anchor, so a number mid-subject becomes the PR
expect: a PR-looking number mid-subject is not the PR

name: DOC_PATH loses the any-depth prefix, so a nested instruction doc reads as code
expect: an instruction document at any depth is not code

name: DOC_PATH loses the basename end anchor, so README-generator.ts reads as documentation
expect: a code file whose name starts with a doc name is still code

name: annotate_code collapses CANNOT RUN into documentation
edits: cache[sha] = None if files is None else files_are_code(files)
expect: an unreadable commit is unknown, not False

name: thread_prs stops recording that a document could not be read
expect: one unreadable document poisons the thread's verdict

name: thread_prs goes back to the two named slots, losing a collision's extra document
edits: for d in thread.get("docs") or [x for x in (thread.get("spec"), thread.get("plan")) if x]:
for d in [x for x in (thread.get("spec"), thread.get("plan")) if x]:
expect: a PR reachable only through a collision's extra document is still found

name: thread_prs stops ordering newest first
edits: prs = sorted(merged.values(), key=lambda p: (p["date"], p["num"]), reverse=True)
expect: a thread's PRs are the union over its documents, deduped, NEWEST FIRST

name: pr_fanout stops accumulating, so every bulk edit reads as a single-document PR
expect: fan-out counts the documents a PR touched

name: render_threads identifies the extra document by a field instead of by identity
expect: a document record with no rel does not crash the renderer

name: render_threads suppresses the fan-out, so a bulk edit poses as this goal's work
edits: fan = f'on {n} documents' if n > 1 else ""
expect: a PR touching many documents renders its fan-out

name: render_threads lets CANNOT RUN read as an honest absence
expect: an unreadable history says so instead of showing nothing

name: excluded_count returns a negative instead of refusing disagreeing populations
edits:
if shown > total:
        raise ValueError(f"shown ({shown}) exceeds total ({total}) — populations disagree")

if False:
        raise ValueError(f"shown ({shown}) exceeds total ({total}) — populations disagree")
expect: showing more than exist is a refusal, not a negative

name: doc_stem strips a suffix anywhere, not only at the end
expect: only a TRAILING suffix is stripped

name: pair_documents drops the extra document instead of keeping it for the renderer
expect: a second document in a slot is kept, not dropped
